notes: Single-page run (user-confirmed scope: homepage only). Every 'cross-page' aggregation in this file is the home page's own aggregation — cross-page = this page. Confidence of palette/type/motif modes is home-only; widen with --pages to confirm.

Computed values come from _computed-styles.json#aggregate (style-census.mjs, widths 1440 and 390; 2 measurements). Rects for heroImage/logo and section spacing come from a JS-off re-render of the captured DOM (pages/en-us.html) at 1440 and 390 — stardust/.work/extract/snapshot-measure.json and sections-measure.json — not from a new live navigation; its document height (3985px at 1440) matches the live full-page screenshot.

Palette cap 8: dropped #d9d9d9 (5, inactive carousel-dot background), #140a9a4d (2, rgba(20,10,154,0.3) carousel dot), #ffc82f (1, carousel control background — it is the CSS-declared secondary-30 brand yellow, see cssUtilityRamps). Census cluster #ffffff absorbs rgb(250,250,250): body/html background is #fafafa (snapshot render, computed) with white content panels (.columncontainer-main.white-container) sitting on it; the footer surface is #fafafa (census surfaces[footer]).
Home-vs-cross-page divergence: not evaluable (one page). Home radius mode is 4px (113 elements, also the area mode); 20px (27) is chip-only; 50% (9) is carousel dots only.
Third-party chrome excluded from motifs: radius 100px (4) and shadow rgba(0,0,0,0.2) 0 4px 8px (4) both come from #ot-sdk-btn-floating (OneTrust cookie widget), not Komatsu markup.

Gradient inventory: the census (computed, non-pseudo) found none; the hero's dark overlay is a ::before pseudo-element declared in clientlib-site CSS (.herocomponent.dark_gradient_overlay:before) and is recorded from that rule.

System component detection requires >= 3 pages; crawl too small (1 page). systemComponents is []. Landmarks observed on the home page only (not confirmed as cross-page): header.experiencefragment.header-xf (logo + Products/Services/Technology/Company + search/Locations/Worldwide US/My Account utilities, absolute over the hero, 82px tall at 1440) and footer.experiencefragment.footer-xf (#fafafa, 4 link columns Discover/Tools/Company/Connect + blue logo block + legal row, 640px tall at 1440).

Second family: Roboto is loaded (census fonts[] status loaded, 400) and declared by clientlib-site CSS for article tag chips (.articleGrid ... .tile .content ul li { font-family: Roboto; font-size: 9pt }). The census's text/heading sample did not include those chips, so type.families counts only Noto Sans.

Logo chain: no inline-SVG wordmark in the header (the only header logo.svg (alt 'Company Logo', 170x34 at top 20px). Its aspect ratio 5.0 exceeds the step-2 guard [0.5, 3.0]; accepted anyway because the guard targets spacer SVGs and the remaining steps resolve to non-logos (no apple-touch-icon; og:image is a social card 'Open-Graph-Default.png'; favicon is 16px-class .ico). Flagged for the reviewer.
